title: Claude Code Setup Pack
summary: The rules, guardrail hooks, memory system and approval gate used daily across 40+ Claude Code projects: block dash characters, warn on ghost-written first-person copy, refuse PDF text extraction until every page was looked at, survive context compaction, and never send anything without a single-use approval.

production.monthly_cost_eur: 0 EUR extra; it runs inside Claude Code, which needs your paid Claude plan (Pro or Max) or API usage
production.incidents: Each hook exists because of a dated incident (see README); none recorded since Aug 2026.
